package.name: mini_ranka_description
package.description:
The Mini_Ranka robot model used by the digital twin: Onshape CAD geometry reworked onto the firmware's kinematic convention, so /joint_states values mean the same thing here as q1/q2/q3 do in ArmKinematics.cpp.
Meshes are reused from the full_assembly package (the raw CAD export) rather than copied, so a re-export only has to land in one place.
